# Meta-Analysis: A Practical and Modern Guide with R

> Open textbook (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) by Mike Nguyen on systematic reviews and meta-analysis with runnable R code (metafor, meta, clubSandwich, netmeta, metaSEM, bayesmeta, brms, RoBMA). Every section has a stable anchor of the form sec-<slug>.

## Chapters

- [Introduction to Research Synthesis](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-introduction.html)
- [The Systematic Review Workflow](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-systematic-review.html)
- [Effect Sizes](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-effect-sizes.html)
- [Common-Effect and Random-Effects Models](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-models.html)
- [Heterogeneity, Subgroups, and Meta-Regression](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-heterogeneity.html)
- [Dependent Effect Sizes](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-dependent-effects.html)
- [Publication Bias and Small-Study Effects](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-publication-bias.html)
- [Sensitivity Analysis and Diagnostics](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-sensitivity.html)
- [Bayesian Meta-Analysis](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-bayesian.html)
- [Network Meta-Analysis](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-network.html)
- [Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-masem.html)
- [Multivariate, Dose-Response, and IPD Meta-Analysis](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-multivariate-ipd.html)
- [Diagnostic Test Accuracy](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-dta.html)
- [Meta-Analysis of Causal Estimates](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-causal-estimates.html)
- [Certainty of Evidence (GRADE) and Reporting](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-reporting.html)
- [A Workflow Checklist](https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/sec-conclusion.html)
